recipes.name: Lemon-Garlic Eggplant with Roasted Broccoli
recipes.description: A savory and tangy dish featuring tender eggplant and crispy broccoli with a hint of garlic and lemon.
recipes.instructions: Start by preheating the oven to 400°F. Take a large baking sheet and line it with parchment paper. In a large bowl, combine 1 large cubed eggplant, 2 cups of broccoli florets, and 2 cloves of minced garlic. Drizzle with 2 tablespoons of olive oil and the juice and zest of 1 lemon. Season with salt and pepper to taste, then toss everything together until well coated. Spread the mixture evenly on the prepared baking sheet. Roast in the oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the eggplant is tender and the broccoli is crispy and lightly browned. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Pineapple and Orange Carrot Salad
recipes.description: A refreshing and vibrant salad that combines the sweetness of pineapple and orange with the crunch of carrots.
recipes.instructions: In a large salad bowl, combine 1 cup of pineapple chunks, 2 grated carrots, segments from 1 orange, and 1 sliced cucumber. In a small bowl, whisk together 1 tablespoon of fresh lemon juice and 1 tablespoon of olive oil. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Pour the dressing over the salad and toss until all the ingredients are well combined. Let the salad sit for 10 minutes to allow the flavors to meld before serving.

recipes.name: Apple and Grape Slaw
recipes.description: A sweet and crunchy slaw featuring fresh apples and grapes with a tangy lemon dressing.
recipes.instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine 2 julienned apples and 1 cup of halved red grapes. In a small bowl, whisk together 1 tablespoon of lemon juice, 1 tablespoon of olive oil, and 1 tablespoon of honey. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Pour the dressing over the apple and grape mixture and toss until evenly coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld.
